en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a Catholic religious gathering in a forested shrine. A group of women, girls, and a priest stand around an enclosed area with statues of the Virgin Mary and a kneeling figure, surrounded by ornate lamp posts and iron railings. At the bottom, in red lettering, is the caption "MONTAGNAGA DI PINE' - 'La Comparsa,'" indicating a Marian apparition site at Montagnaga di Pinè.
